user.title: Mon Espace Famille account
user.description: The email and password you use on app.monespacefamille.fr. Each child registered to a service (canteen, before- or after-school care, study hall) gets a device.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Mon Espace Famille no longer accepts the password of {email}.

error.cannot_connect: Mon Espace Famille cannot be reached, try again later.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data_description.semaines: Weeks read after the current one, every 30 minutes. "Booking missing" needs at least 1.

tarifs.title: Prices
tarifs.description: Defaults are Orgerus 2026-27. The per-day price of each service comes from the portal (it follows each child's profile); fill a price below only to override it. Morning and evening care are billed per day up to the number of days below, then a monthly flat fee.

data.cap_days: Days after which the monthly flat fee applies (0 = never)
data.flat_accueil_matin: Monthly flat fee, morning care (empty or 0 = none)
data.flat_accueil_soir: Monthly flat fee, evening care (empty or 0 = none)
data.price_repas: Canteen price per day (empty = the portal's)
data.price_accueil_matin: Morning care price per day (empty = the portal's)
data.price_accueil_soir: Evening care price per day (empty = the portal's)
data.price_etude: Study hall price per day (empty = the portal's)

horaires.title: Hours
horaires.description: Defaults are the official Orgerus hours. They feed the calendar, the card and the expected return time.

error.end_before_start: The end must be after the start.

reserver.name: Book
reserver.description: Books days of a service for a child, then checks Mon Espace Famille shows them.

enfant.name: Child
enfant.description: The child's device (an entity of the child works too).

service.name: Service
service.description: repas, accueil_matin, accueil_soir or etude; or the service id Mon Espace Famille uses, such as 1_1.

dates.name: Dates
dates.description: The days, YYYY-MM-DD. Days already booked are skipped.

annuler.name: Cancel
annuler.description: Cancels booked days of a service for a child, before the cancellation deadline, then checks Mon Espace Famille no longer shows them.

enfant.name: Child
enfant.description: The child's device (an entity of the child works too).

service.name: Service
service.description: repas, accueil_matin, accueil_soir or etude; or the service id Mon Espace Famille uses, such as 1_1.

dates.name: Dates
dates.description: The booked days to cancel, YYYY-MM-DD.

unknown_child.message: {child} is not a child of a Mon Espace Famille account.

not_open.message: {service} cannot be booked on {dates}: closed that day, or past the booking deadline.

too_late.message: {service} on {dates} can no longer be cancelled: the deadline has passed.

not_confirmed.message: Mon Espace Famille took the request but does not show it yet for {dates}; check the app before trying again.

auth_failed.message: Mon Espace Famille refused the login; log in again from the integration.

api_error.message: Mon Espace Famille did not answer as expected: {error}

needs_evening.message: The study hall of {dates} needs the evening care booked the same day.

has_study.message: The evening care of {dates} cannot be cancelled while the study hall stays booked.
